Dopo la chiusura delle iscrizioni (ore 14 di martedì 17/11/26), ogni studente riceverà la lista dettagliata con le date e gli orari delle interrogazioni. After the registration deadline (Tuesday 17th of November 2026 at 14.00), each student will receive the list with the dates and times of the examinations. The duration of the examination on site is about 1 hour, so divided: first, some exercises to solve (1/2 hour); then, questions regarding the course topics analysed during lessons (1/2 hour).
